title: Tensura Metalworks
description: Tensura Metalworks brings magical metallurgy to Tensura Reincarnated with new alloys, molten metals, Silent Gear materials, EP scaling, engravings, and legendary equipment.
body:
# Tensura Metalworks **Tensura Metalworks** brings magical metallurgy to **Tensura Reincarnated**, expanding the way players craft, forge, upgrade, and evolve powerful equipment. Built around **Tensura Reincarnated**, **Silent Gear**, **Silent Gear Metalworks**, and **Productive Metalworks**, this addon adds a full metalworking progression path using molten metals, magical alloys, Tensura-inspired materials, EP-supported gear, automatic engravings, advancements, config options, and endgame equipment. ## Features; * New magical materials, including **Biological Magisteel**, **Dragotite**, **Alienium**, **Spiritium**, and **Starheart** * Productive Metalworks foundry support with molten metals, melting, casting, alloying, and Elemental Lava fuel * Silent Gear integration for custom parts, materials, traits, coatings, and gear progression * Tensura EP support for supported tools, weapons, armour, and endgame equipment * Automatic Tensura engravings for custom gear and selected Silent Gear materials * Endgame Starheart equipment with high-tier stats and God-grade progression * Legendary weapons: **Caliburn** and **Excalibur** * Custom crafting, smithing, brewing, loot, and advancement progression * Config toggles for major systems * Read-only info commands for checking config, compat, EP values, systems, engravings, and flight status ## Progression; Tensura Metalworks is designed around a magical metallurgy progression path: **Magisteel → Biological Magisteel → Dragotite / Alienium / Spiritium → Starheart → Caliburn / Excalibur** Players begin by working with Tensura materials and foundry processes, then gradually progress into stronger magical alloys. Each major material has its own identity, use, and place in the equipment path. ## Materials;

Biological Magisteel

A fusion material created through advanced foundry processing, combining molten Magisteel with Insector-based remains. Biological Magisteel acts as the foundation for several higher-tier alloys and Silent Gear parts.

Dragotite

A powerful draconic metal used for high-tier armour, tools, and weapons. Dragotite equipment is built around strength, durability, draconic power, and advanced Tensura engravings.

Alienium

A biological alien metal inspired by Insectar material progression. Alienium gear focuses on unusual alien-steel properties, energy interaction, and magicule-rich equipment growth.

Spiritium

A custom spirit-aligned alloy created for this addon. Spiritium equipment focuses on elemental force, spiritual power, and magicule channeling.

Starheart

The endgame God-grade material of Tensura Metalworks. Starheart equipment represents the peak of the addon’s gear progression, leading into the legendary weapons Caliburn and Excalibur.

 

## Foundry Integration;

Tensura Metalworks adds several molten fluids and foundry recipes through Productive Metalworks, allowing players to melt, alloy, and cast magical metals.

Included foundry content:

  • Molten Magisteel
  • Molten Biological Magisteel
  • Molten Dragotite
  • Molten Alienium
  • Molten Spiritium
  • Molten Starheart
  • Molten Insector Remains
  • Elemental Lava

Elemental Lava can also be used as a high-temperature foundry fuel, giving the addon a unique Tensura-themed foundry progression.

 

## Silent Gear Integration;

The addon expands Silent Gear progression with Tensura-themed materials, coatings, linings, rods, bindings, and traits.

Supported Silent Gear content includes:

  • Custom materials and parts
  • Foundry-cast gear components
  • Tensura-inspired traits
  • EP-compatible supported tools and weapons
  • Automatic engravings from selected materials and gear combinations

This allows Tensura materials to feel properly integrated into Silent Gear instead of existing as separate standalone items.

 

EP and Engravings; Tensura Metalworks uses Tensura Reincarnated’s EP system for supported gear.

 

Custom equipment and supported Silent Gear items can receive:

  • Base EP
  • Maximum EP
  • EP gain values
  • Tensura engravings
  • Material-specific effects and scaling

The goal is to make gear progression feel connected to Tensura Reincarnated’s power system while still respecting Minecraft’s crafting and equipment progression.

 

## Endgame Equipment; Tensura Metalworks adds powerful endgame equipment, including: * Dragotite armour, tools, and weapons * Alienium armour, tools, and weapons * Spiritium armour, tools, and weapons * Starheart armour, tools, and weapons * Caliburn * Excalibur * Starheart, Caliburn, and Excalibur are intended to sit at the highest end of the addon’s progression. ## Advancements, Config, and Commands; The addon includes advancement progression to guide players through the major crafting stages and material upgrades.

Config options allow server owners and modpack creators to enable or disable major systems such as:

  • Silent Gear EP bridge
  • Custom gear EP
  • Automatic engravings
  • Armour flight
  • Debug logging

Read-only commands are also included to check addon information without giving items or bypassing progression.

 

## Dependencies **Required:** [Tensura Reincarnated](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/tensura-reincarnated) - 2.0.10+ [Silent Gear](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/silent-gear) - 4.2.1.1+ [Silent Gear Metalworks](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/silent-gear-metalworks) - 1.21.1-1.5.0 + [Productive Metalworks](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/productive-metalworks) - 1.21.1-1.50 + Built for: * Minecraft 1.21.1 * NeoForge (Only!) ## Notes Tensura Metalworks is an unofficial addon made for Tensura Reincarnated-focused modpacks. It is designed to expand metalworking, gear progression, Silent Gear & Productive Metalworks integration while keeping the experience themed around Tensura-style magical materials.
